What it is for:

A connection manager and viewer to reach remote desktops (VNC servers) quickly and securely, to group saved connections, and to run several sessions at once in tabs. File download/upload is also supported in the window thanks to TightVNC 2.x file transfer support.

What it is built with:

  • C++17 and Qt Widgets — Qt 6.8.3 LTS, single static exe build
  • RFB client: libvncclient (LibVNCServer client library; vcpkg overlay port + patch)
  • Image compression: zlib and libjpeg-turbo (Tight encoding)
  • Build: CMake + Ninja + MSVC (VS2019 BuildTools) with vcpkg for dependency management
  • Version: produced from the VERSION file at the repo root, incremented by 1 on every build (0.99.x)

Made by:

Developed by: MiMo with Şahin AKIN · project: github.com/strdex/VNCManager

Servers it works with: TightVNC 2.x (full support + file transfer), TigerVNC/TurboVNC/RealVNC (standard RFB), UltraVNC (viewing), x11vnc and LibVNCServer-based servers.

0.99.11 – 0.99.12 — English translation: the entire interface can now also run in English; the language is selected from the View menu, the preference is remembered and it takes effect when the application restarts. The ChangeLog window records the latest builds, and a small spelling fix was made in the About window.

0.99.9 – 0.99.10 — Changelog window updated with the recent builds: file transfer changes recorded.

0.99.7 – 0.99.8 — File transfer window: now starts at the drive level on every launch; remembering the last opened folder was removed. Panes were framed in group boxes, per-pane “↑” (up) and “Drives” buttons were added, transfer buttons were enlarged, margins and row layout were tightened.

0.99.5 – 0.99.6 — Help menu added: “About” and “Changelog” windows.

0.99.3 – 0.99.4 — Collapsible left panel: the connection list can be hidden and brought back with Ctrl+Shift+L, a toolbar button or the View menu; its state is kept across restarts and it returns with its previous width. The shortcut also works while controlling the remote screen.

0.99.1 – 0.99.2 — Keyboard input is forwarded to the remote system: Del, Ctrl+C/V/X, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+0/1, Ctrl+Tab, F5 now reach the remote screen; window shortcuts are disabled in control mode. What stays local: F11, Ctrl+Shift+C/V/F/L, Ctrl+wheel. The version number is produced from the VERSION file and incremented on every build; the build number is visible in the exe properties.

0.99 — First release: connection profiles and groups, quick connect, multiple tabs, view-only/control mode, scaling (fit/1:1/zoom), full screen, bidirectional clipboard sync, Ctrl+Alt+Del and Windows key sending, TightVNC 2.x file transfer, import/export of the connection list.
